summary.result: By combining these results, The vulnerable areas of the rural villages and the emergency relief service facilities were calculated and classified into 5 levels.
summary.background: Based on the calculated statistics data, the police facilities are the most important, While the fire fighting and hospital facilities are important as well.
summary.method: Hence in order to further supplement the vulnerable areas to emergency relief service in villages, geographical relocation and policy approach of emergency relief service facilities are necessary.
